name: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum
storyline: Artus is a little mouse who lives, with his two parents, inside a museum that houses a gallery of masterpiece paintings. One evening, while Artus's parents have gone out in town, a snowstorm cuts the museum off from the outside world. And the Museum Demon, who had disappeared from the memory of the living, chooses that very evening to return and haunt the museum. Following a wrong move, your avatar (well, you!) triggers the curse: the demon scrambles the paintings and transforms them into hideous gouache monstrosities. Fortunately, Artus has magical powers to enter a parallel dimension where the characters from the paintings live their lives. And you, who caused this disaster, will use your brain to solve the puzzles that will allow the paintings to regain their former glory. A great adventure for juniors, but children helped by older kids or adults if possible!
summary: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum is a point-and-click adventure game designed as an educational game to teach children about classical paintings, their history and creators with its main character Artus de mouse.
